column1: # SR-01 T-ACT 101: a third-party action or reusable workflow is pinned to a full commit SHA
# SR-02 T-TAG 30: an own-organization reference names a commit, not a movable tag or branch (advisory: decision 5)
# SR-03 T-INJ 0: no value a PR or issue author chooses is spliced into a script
# SR-11 T-INJ 57: no ref name, input, matrix, env, var or step output is spliced into a script (pass it through env)
# SR-04 T-CRED 6: a workflow declares its permissions, and never write-all
# SR-05 T-PR 0: no trigger runs with secrets on fork content (pull_request_target, workflow_run, issue_comment)
# SR-06 T-BUILD 21: a job that can sign, write the repository or push packages runs no dependency code
# SR-12 T-PR 14: code from a pull request never runs in a job that can sign or write (a same-repository PR gets the full grant)
# SR-07 T-BOOT 3: nothing downloaded is piped to an interpreter, and a downloaded file is verified (sha256sum -c, cosign verify) before use
# SR-08 T-ACT 8: no secret reaches a third-party action not pinned by SHA, directly or through env or an input
# SR-09 T-CRED 37: a checkout in a job that can write does not leave its token in .git/config (persist-credentials: false)
# SR-10 T-SIG 0: a signature check pins the exact signer workflow, the issuer and the source repository
# SR-13 T-IMG 2: a container or docker:// image is pinned by digest
